summary: The @gyomu/agent package serves as an AI-driven agent module within the gyomu project ecosystem. It integrates core AI capabilities, infrastructure, schema validation, and TypeScript documentation parsing to execute intelligent analysis tasks.
responsibilities: Orchestrate AI interactions using underlying foundational packages.
Integrate schema definitions and infrastructure components for agent operations.
Provide automated test validation and quality assurance for analytical components.

capabilities.name: Agent Execution
capabilities.description: Enables the orchestration and execution of AI-driven tasks leveraging core gyomu packages.

capabilities.name: Testing Infrastructure
capabilities.description: Provides automated verification tools and test suites to ensure the correctness of agent operations.

designDecisions: Built as an ES module utilizing modern TypeScript tooling and the Effect framework.
Depends on modular gyomu ecosystem packages to separate AI, infrastructure, schema, and documentation parsing concerns.
usageGuidance: Import package features through the established public API entries.
Ensure compatible dependent packages from the @gyomu namespace are configured in the consuming environment.
